direction.camera: Guide attention with airy composition; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: keep weight near the center and generous light margins; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with thin strokes; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with soft geometry.
direction.lighting: large diffuse ceiling; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: translucent polymer and pearl finish; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around pale space; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use airy composition,thin strokes,small label,slow float,pale space,soft geometry as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
